transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ___. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doc. Well, I came in because... I just feel like I got a motor running inside me all day long. If I have to sit still—like at church, or out in the waiting room here, or even just at home—I start feeling trapped. I just have to get up or do something. I just can't stay put.
Did you have this same restlessness when you were a child?

Yeah, I did. It's been like this for as long as I can remember. Back when I was a boy in school, the teachers were always moving my seat around because I just could not stay put. I'd talk out of turn a lot, and... well, I was always getting in trouble for jumping up out of my chair before class was even done.
Do you ever get unwanted thoughts that keep coming back into your mind even when you try to push them away?

No, I can't say that I do. I don't really get thoughts stuck in my head like that. If anything, my mind is just always jumping around to a hundred different things. But no, I don't have unwanted thoughts that just keep coming back and bothering me.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things most days?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... I don't really sit around worrying about a bunch of stuff. My problem is more just having to be doing something all the time. But no, I don't really get all worked up worrying about things most days.
Do you usually feel a strong need for things to be done perfectly or in a very specific way?

No, not really. I'm not much of a perfectionist. I don't really care if things are done a certain way, I just... I just want to get them done and move on to the next thing, you know? So, no, I don't have that need for everything to be perfect.
